text: minervini: "Near-vertical thrust with RS 97.57: the power-play precondition." I share the strength read; it is top over every horizon (C23). But my position system buys the break, not the precondition: structure_shift is RANGE on the bar, so no resistance break is in progress (C26), and the impulse is flat with no TIF confirmation (C28). A precondition with no trigger is not a signal I can take. I hold OPPOSE. Clears it: structure_shift BULLISH_BOS on the next bar, then a buy stop over bar_high.
